subject: imGHUM kickoff - implicit human models for scan completion
body:
Team,

Kicking off imGHUM. Our release gives us implicit generative models of 3D human shape, facial expression, and articulated pose that share the GHUM latent space - with gender-neutral and gender-specific models for full body, head, and both hands. Two properties make it a product candidate: fast differentiable signed-distance queries at arbitrary spatial points, and topology-freedom, which lets imGHUM sit as the inner layer under personalized, clothed, animatable humans.

The concrete bet for this window: point-cloud reconstruction and completion for our scan-processing pipeline. Partial scans are today's biggest source of manual cleanup, and imGHUM's SDF queries plus semantics should automate a big slice of it.

Milestones: models integrated and SDF-query benchmarks by mid-May, scan-completion evaluation on our internal capture set by mid-June, go/no-go memo by 2026-06-29.

Yara leads research, Efe evaluation, Farah and Gustavo the pipeline integration. Daniela - resourcing note please.

Lucia
